definitions.explanation: The act of briefly closing and opening the eyes.
The flickering or sparkling of stars, lights, or other luminous objects.

definitions.gloss: instant; moment; blink of an eye
definitions.explanation: A very brief period of time, used figuratively to describe how quickly something happened.

examples.japanese: {瞬|またた}きもせずに{画面|がめん}を{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: I was watching the screen without even blinking.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}すると{瞬|またた}きの{回数|かいすう}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: When you're nervous, the frequency of blinking increases.

examples.japanese: コンタクトレンズをしていると{瞬|またた}きの{回数|かいすう}を{意識|いしき}するようになる。
examples.english: When wearing contact lenses, you become more aware of how often you blink.

examples.japanese: {星|ほし}の{瞬|またた}きが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The twinkling of the stars is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くの{街|まち}の{灯|あか}りが{瞬|またた}いている。
examples.english: The lights of the distant town are twinkling.

examples.japanese: {夜空|よぞら}に{無数|むすう}の{星|ほし}が{瞬|またた}き、{息|いき}を{呑|の}むほどの{美|うつく}しさだった。
examples.english: Countless stars twinkled in the night sky — it was breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.japanese: {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{時間|じかん}が{過|す}ぎた。
examples.english: Time passed in the twinkling of an eye.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}は{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The fire spread in an instant.

examples.japanese: あの{事故|じこ}は{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}の{出来事|できごと}で、{誰|だれ}も{反応|はんのう}できなかった。
examples.english: That accident happened in an instant, and no one could react.

notes:
From the verb {瞬|またた}く (to blink; to twinkle). The three senses are all connected through the idea of something brief and flickering. The expression {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に (in the twinkling of an eye) is literary and emphatic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞬|またた}きもしない: not even blink (from concentration or shock)
- {星|ほし}の{瞬|またた}き: the twinkling of stars
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に: in the blink of an eye; in an instant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- まばたき: blink — the more common everyday word for blinking the eyes; same kanji {瞬|まばた}き
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}: an instant — same kanji {瞬|しゅん}; the most common word for "a moment"
- きらめき: sparkle; glitter — emphasizes brilliance and beauty more than flickering
